description: Seed library of graph grammar configs. Each entry renders via render_graph_grammar.gd. Covers tree, rhizome, coral, space-colonization, and iteration-driven growth.

configs.notes: Iterative branching — each generation spawns 3 children from every leaf.
Narrow conifer — less splay, smaller children.
Wide oak — 4 children per node with big splay.
Sideways-growing rhizome — root direction flipped to horizontal by tweaking initial spread past 90.
Space colonization toward an ellipsoid canopy — natural tree silhouette.
Space colonization toward a cone — cypress/pyramid silhouette.
Attractors arranged in a torus — ring/crown topology.
First spawn two levels, then let space colonization fill the canopy.
Branches get subdivided after spawning — gives visible kinks/joints.
Dense 5-child branching, fewer generations — bush.
gen00 tree_classic with bark/plant shaders — leaves on leaves.
Tree with leaf_tuft foliage at the tips.
Cypress — narrow branching with bright green tufts.
Tree with red-orange foliage.
Space colonization ellipsoid canopy with bark+plant shaders.
Dense red branching — coral/sea fan.
Low wide fern-like spread with green tufts.
Dense tree with tiny tufts everywhere — grass-like.
Torus colonization with tighter cloud center — should reach the ring.
Pure leaf_tuft on root — explosion of bristles in all directions.
The red urchin — same topology, rendered as marching-cubes smooth union. Soft fusion at roots, bristles remain distinct.
Heavy smoothing on a 64-bristle urchin — bristles blur into a spiked organ.
The classic tree but marching-cubes smooth. Branches fuse at forks like molten metal.
Red coral — metaball version at 3 generations to keep segment count manageable.
Classic tree + light position noise — subtle organic wobble.
Same tree with aggressive noise — gnarled wind-beaten form.
Tree with noise-modulated radii — knotty bark-like thickness variation.
Position AND radius noise — full organic variation.
Horizontal rhizome + XZ-only displacement — wild meander along the ground.
Space-colonized canopy with horizontal noise bias — windblown.
Bristle ball with radius noise — varied bristle thickness.
Coral metaball with high jitter — limbs cross and fuse in unexpected ways.
Fewer iterations, fatter starting radius — chubby organism with short fat fingers.
Ochre fungal cluster — softer smoothing, warmer color, reads as mushroom growth.
Ivory/bone coloring — reads as carved bone or coral skeleton.
Two seed roots offset 0.8m apart — two creatures fusing at the hip.
Three seeds in an equilateral triangle — trinity organism.
Sine radii along depth — bamboo/reed segments.
Serpentine trunk — sine displacement along height drives X-axis wiggle.
Full tree with pulse-wave radii — rhythmic thickness along every branch.
Dense tree with RD-spots displacement — Turing dots modulate Y-position, giving dappled canopy.
RD stripes pattern drives vertical displacement — ridged foliage.
Space-colonized canopy + RD mazes displacement — organic labyrinth structure.
Seeder: 12 seeds scattered by Poisson disk across a disk, each grows a small tree. A forest from one config.
8 scatter seeds + coral recipe + metaball — colony of fused creatures.
Single chain trunk displaced by helix curve — coiling vine.
Chain trunk bent through a trefoil-knot trajectory — the branch knots itself.
Branching tree + lissajous curve displacement — each branch bends through an interference pattern.
Space-colonized canopy displaced by a 4-petal rose curve in XZ — radial petaled silhouette.
Archimedean spiral displacement on a simple stack — nodes climb while winding outward.
Dense bush + Fay butterfly-curve displacement — chaotic wing-like spread on the XY plane.
Chain displaced by the figure-eight knot curve — complex looping structure.
Torus (2,3) knot — classic pretzel traced by a capsule chain.
5-petal rose displacement on a dense bush — pentagonal flower cluster.
Seashell logarithmic spiral — tightens as it grows, organic fossil shape.
Tree with 8-fold wave-torus displacement — radial flanged structure.
Enneper-surface-inspired displacement on a coral metaball — cusped organic form.
Helicoid displacement — radius-growing helix tower.
Breather curve displacement — amplitude pulses over the trunk.
Branch recipe + 4-fold symmetry = 4-arm mandala topology.
6-fold symmetry — hexagonal mandala.
Coral recipe + 5-fold symmetry + metaball — starfish creature. Reduced depth for rendering feasibility.
Scatter forest + Conway's Game of Life pruning — trees survive only in CA-alive cells.
Seeds rule (B2/S) — explosive growth pattern prunes forest into quickly-filling clusters.
Day-and-night rule — symmetric patterns, produces stable islands and continents of growth.
Coral creature inside a convex hull 'cage' — wireframe membrane around the form.
Tree + tight convex hull — branches pressing against a skin.
Hull + metaball — organism fuses with its membrane into a single smooth shell.
Conway CA directly SEEDS the forest — one tree per alive cell. Ecology IS the CA pattern.
HighLife CA (B36/S23) — produces replicators and gliders, seeds form moving patterns.
Day-and-Night CA — symmetric rules produce large stable islands and continents.
Seeds CA (B2/S) — maximally explosive rule. Produces oscillating patterns.
Life-without-Death (B3/S012345678) — cells once alive stay alive, growth accumulates. Produces dense labyrinths.
Conway + higher density + more iterations — tighter ecological patches.
CA-seeded CORAL forest + metaball — colonies form in CA patterns, fuse smoothly.
Wide autumn forest — Conway CA over larger region + red foliage.
Forest grows ONLY inside the Mandelbrot set. Fractal boundary as ecology.
Julia set (c = -0.7 + 0.27i) — dragon-like fractal shape in the forest.
Different Julia c — different fractal shape, different forest.
Burning Ship fractal — angular antenna-like boundary, produces geometric forest silhouettes.
Koch edge subdivision at depth 2 — every branch bumps into a triangular zigzag.
Single chain + Koch depth 3 — fractal lightning bolt.
Room → 2 tables → 3 books per table → 1 pen per book. Reads as a library left-to-right.
Workshop: room with multiple tables, each with cups and books.
Anthropometry: torso → 2 arms → forearms → hands → fingers. Body as Modulor fold.
Kitchen counter with many cups and books.
Room containing 3 smaller rooms (fold category OVERRIDE). Architectural nesting.
Lindsey Adelman Branching Bubble Chandelier (2006) — single trunk splits into 3 Y-branches, frosted glass bulbs at tips.
Larger Adelman family — 5 bulbs. Trunk splits into 5 branches.
Two branching generations — 6 final bulbs, richer tree.
Brass-toned chandelier with 7 bulbs — richer, more ornate variant.
Same chandelier grammar → molecule diagram. Big colored emissive spheres at every node (including joints) with colored rods between. Ada's teaching aesthetic.
Scattered forest + RD spots displacement — a dappled grove, patterns emerge across trees.
Dense branching + heavy noise on positions and radii — bramble.
L-system plant DNA (F->F[+F]F[-F]F at 25.7°) rendered as a graph chandelier. Dark metal edges, frosted glass leaf spheres. Same DNA as lsystem-gallery ls03 tube-tree, now Adelman chandelier.
Same L-system plant DNA, post-processed with Modulor fold. Each leaf selected and folded down one Modulor rung — the tree becomes scaled-down objects at each tip.
Same L-system plant DNA, then koch_edge_op subdivides every edge with a Koch-style bump. The plant becomes a fractal zigzag — two grammars composed.

TRIPLE DNA BRIDGE: L-system plant → soft-body sim (140 steps, low stiffness, diagonal wind) → graph-grammar chandelier. The post-wind collapsed tree pose becomes a chandelier. Same DNA as sb_ls02_plant_wind_collapse but rendered as Adelman glass-and-metal.
TRIPLE DNA BRIDGE: Same L-system plant, but stiff + gentle gravity — 60 steps, mostly stands. Chandelier traces a more vertical tree shape.
DNA BRIDGE: L-system plant + universal noise-displace post-op. Every node jitters by 3D simplex noise — straight branches become organic wobbly branches. Same DNA plus noise as modifier.

DNA BRIDGE: Same L-system plant, but noise_type=cellular (Worley/Voronoi noise) with larger amplitude. Nodes snap to Voronoi-cell centers, producing a more crystalline shape. Noise-type as DNA variable.

QUADRUPLE DNA BRIDGE: Life-without-Death CA → soft-body cloth (pinned corners, wind) → graph from post-sim pose → chandelier render. Four substrates in one config. DNA flows: rule → pattern → physics → topology → glass.

QUINTUPLE DNA BRIDGE: CA → soft-body → graph → noise-post-op → chandelier. All three bridge shapes stacked in one config: forward-seeder, reverse-pose, universal-post-op. DNA survives rule + physics + perturbation.
DNA BRIDGE: Gray-Scott coral pattern → graph (above-threshold cells as nodes, 4-neighbors as edges, V as height) → chandelier render. The coral reef becomes a glowing pearl constellation.
DNA BRIDGE: Gray-Scott stripes pattern → graph → capsule render. Brain/fingerprint ridges materialized as green-teal capsule nodes following the V field.
